name: Schaafheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner quartered red and yellow, charged in the upper half with the municipal arms of Schaafheim (chevrons, a wolf's hook and a lion).
history: The municipal flag was approved on 5 December 1986 and is described as the arms on the upper half of a red and gold quartered cloth.

features.role: Schaafheim arms — chevrons, wolf's hook and lion
